Optional local binaries: place ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe here, or install both
on PATH. They are not downloaded automatically. Use a Windows build providing
gdigrab, dshow, libx264, and AAC. FFmpeg 9.0.2 was used for local verification.

For a self-contained build, run build.ps1 -BundleFFmpeg. Consult
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md before redistributing third-party binaries.
